info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Points-v3-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Points Retrieval API provides access to customer loyalty point balances within the loyalty program. This endpoint allows clients to query the loyalty points associated with specific customers, enabling businesses to reward and engage their valued customers effectively. Typical use cases include customer service applications checking points for specific accounts and marketing tools assessing loyalty status for targeted promotions. By integrating with this API, businesses can enhance customer experiences through personalized rewards and incentives.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current loyalty points balance and associated details for a customer. It provides insights into how many points a customer has accrued and how they can be redeemed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the loyalty points associated with a user. It provides the necessary information for the operation, ensuring that the correct data is accessed.
